description: Korean wage guarantee payment (대지급금) the state pays first for unpaid wages and severance: simple payment for retired workers (wages 7M + severance 7M, total 10M KRW), simple payment for current low-income workers (7M), or insolvency payment with age-based monthly caps (220/310/350/330/230만원) covering the last 6 months of wages when the insolvency decision is on or after 2026-08-20 (3 months before) and the last 3 years of severance.

afterReform.description: Insolvency decision on or after 2026-08-20 (default true)

age.description: Age at retirement (or application if employed)

kind.description: simpleRetired = retired, employer still exists; simpleEmployed = still employed; insolvency = rehabilitation, bankruptcy or recognised insolvency

serviceYears.description: Years of service behind the severance

unpaidMonths.description: Number of final months not paid

name: calculate_kr_wage_guarantee
title: Calculate Korea wage guarantee
